proposal.question: PROMOTE DEWEY's N-PORT holder-scanner script (the thing that found the fund holders of data-center bonds in REQ-007 v2) from a one-off to a kept tool?
proposal.context: A build gate under DEWEY's charter: a kept tool is maintained, documented and tested; a one-off is evidence only.

choices.label: Yes — keep it as a DEWEY tool
choices.meaning: Keep the scanner as a DEWEY tool with a README and ONE selftest, NO schedule.
choices.consequence: A reusable tool is maintained by DEWEY; no unattended run is granted.

choices.label: No — one-off
choices.meaning: Retain the evidence; do not maintain a reusable tool.
choices.consequence: No tool maintenance is assigned; a future need re-derives the scan.

recommendation.reason: The scanner already produced the REQ-007 v2 holder list; keeping it avoids another discovery pass. No schedule, so no unattended-run grant rides on it.

caveats: No schedule: the approval does not grant an unattended run.
proposal.submission_block_reason: Design copy; the unit is already ruled.

timing.meaning: The row's needed-by as registered (shared with CDR); the NPORT unit itself carried no separate deadline.
